name: Town of Pound Ridge
gaps: No fixed lot (impervious) coverage maximum: the schedule shows '-' with site-plan thresholds of 7,000/9,000/12,000 sf (R-1A/R-2A/R-3A); recorded as text
No floor-area limit for residences (FAR 'NA' in residential districts)
No side-yard total; no separate accessory height limit found
Building coverage over 2,600/3,600/4,500 sf (R-1A/R-2A/R-3A) needs Planning Board site plan approval and enlarged yards; the 10% cap still applies
PB-A/PB-B/PB-C business districts not checked for one-family use

wetlands.summary: Ch. 63: 150 ft minimum activity setback (measured horizontally) around controlled areas (wetlands, water bodies, watercourses); activities in a controlled area or the setback need a Water Control Commission or administrative permit.

steep_slopes.summary: Ch. 89: steep slope permit to disturb slopes of 25%+ (min 25 ft horizontal, over 500 sf; areas within 25 ft combine); extra Planning Board findings for slopes over 35%. § 113-22 adds hilltop/ridgeline protection.

trees.summary: Ch. 93: permit to remove trees 6 in.+ dbh on slopes over 15%, within 25 ft of a property line or in wetland setbacks; specimen trees 24 in.+ or protected trees anywhere; 12 in.+ on subdividable acreage; any clear-cutting.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 91B: SWPPP/stormwater permit for land development activity disturbing 5,000 sf or more (smaller jobs may need one when under Planning Board or Water Control Commission review).

adu.summary: § 113-39: accessory apartments in R-2A and R-3A only, owner-occupied, one per lot, Planning Board site plan review; 300-1,200 sf and max 30% of the house's gross floor area, max 2 bedrooms, Health Dept septic/water approval.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings use the schedule's accessory side/rear yards (R-1A 20/25 ft; R-2A 50/50; R-3A 50/75) and the front yard; no residential use of accessory buildings except approved accessory apartments (§ 113-38C).
general.pools: All pools must be fenced (§ 113-38A(6)); no pool-specific setbacks found, so the accessory/principal yards apply.
general.notes: Each lot needs contiguous dry land equal to 75% of the minimum lot area (§ 113-16); Article XIV discounts wetlands, floodplain and steep slopes in lot-area calculations for new lots. Paved terraces may not come closer than 25 ft to any lot line.

R-1A.name: R-1A Residential (1 acre)

max_building_coverage.note: Planning Board site plan approval needed above 2,600 sf of building coverage; yards and buffers then grow in 5 ft steps (note 4). Unroofed paved terraces excluded; roofed/enclosable porches count (§ 113-38A(1))

max_impervious_coverage.text: No fixed maximum lot coverage; site plan approval needed above 7,000 sf of lot coverage (buildings, structures and paved areas), with yards and buffers increased in 5 ft steps (note 4)

accessory.notes: Accessory side/rear yards from the bulk schedule; no separate accessory front yard or height given

R-1A.notes: 1 acre(s) per dwelling; lot needs 0.75 acres of contiguous dry land at least 25 ft wide (§ 113-16) and a 150 ft horizontal circle containing a house site outside wetland setbacks (note 2). 10 ft undisturbed buffer at all lot lines (inside the yards; no buildings, driveways, septic or utilities without Planning Board approval, note 3). 25 ft minimum street frontage (§ 113-15). Corner lots: front-yard depth on each street (§ 113-38A(11)). Planning Board may set larger supplementary setbacks on new lots (§ 113-37B).

R-2A.name: R-2A Residential (2 acres)

max_building_coverage.note: Planning Board site plan approval needed above 3,600 sf of building coverage; yards and buffers then grow in 5 ft steps (note 4). Unroofed paved terraces excluded; roofed/enclosable porches count (§ 113-38A(1))

max_impervious_coverage.text: No fixed maximum lot coverage; site plan approval needed above 9,000 sf of lot coverage (buildings, structures and paved areas), with yards and buffers increased in 5 ft steps (note 4)

accessory.notes: Accessory side/rear yards from the bulk schedule; no separate accessory front yard or height given

R-2A.notes: 2 acre(s) per dwelling; lot needs 1.5 acres of contiguous dry land at least 25 ft wide (§ 113-16) and a 200 ft horizontal circle containing a house site outside wetland setbacks (note 2). 15 ft undisturbed buffer at all lot lines (inside the yards; no buildings, driveways, septic or utilities without Planning Board approval, note 3). 25 ft minimum street frontage (§ 113-15). Corner lots: front-yard depth on each street (§ 113-38A(11)). Planning Board may set larger supplementary setbacks on new lots (§ 113-37B).

R-3A.name: R-3A Residential (3 acres)

max_building_coverage.note: Planning Board site plan approval needed above 4,500 sf of building coverage; yards and buffers then grow in 5 ft steps (note 4). Unroofed paved terraces excluded; roofed/enclosable porches count (§ 113-38A(1))

max_impervious_coverage.text: No fixed maximum lot coverage; site plan approval needed above 12,000 sf of lot coverage (buildings, structures and paved areas), with yards and buffers increased in 5 ft steps (note 4)

accessory.notes: Accessory side/rear yards from the bulk schedule; no separate accessory front yard or height given

R-3A.notes: 3 acre(s) per dwelling; lot needs 2.25 acres of contiguous dry land at least 25 ft wide (§ 113-16) and a 250 ft horizontal circle containing a house site outside wetland setbacks (note 2). 20 ft undisturbed buffer at all lot lines (inside the yards; no buildings, driveways, septic or utilities without Planning Board approval, note 3). 25 ft minimum street frontage (§ 113-15). Corner lots: front-yard depth on each street (§ 113-38A(11)). Planning Board may set larger supplementary setbacks on new lots (§ 113-37B).

LNG.name: LNG Landscape Nursery and Garden Center (one-family dwellings)

max_building_coverage.note: Site plan thresholds in note 4 are stated for R-1A/R-2A/R-3A only

accessory.notes: Accessory side/rear yards from the bulk schedule; no separate accessory front yard or height given

LNG.notes: Schedule row for one-family dwellings in LNG: 2 acres per dwelling, 1.5 acres contiguous dry land, 200 ft circle, 250 ft depth, 15 ft buffer. Nursery/garden center use has its own row (20 acres, 100 ft yards, 500 ft frontage on a state or county highway).
